claim: Nigeria’s Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala has been appointed the new and first female Director-General of the World Trade Organisation (WTO).

sub_claims.question: Is Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala Nigerian?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala is a Nigerian economist and former Finance Minister of Nigeria.

evidence.statement: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala was born on June 13, 1954, in Ogwashi-Ukwu, Delta State, Nigeria.
Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala served as Nigeria's Minister of Finance from 2003 to 2006 and again from 2011 to 2015.
